creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, 2026-09-28: "hyperlink clicking doesn't seem to work?"

libghostty reports a cmd-click on a link (an OSC 8 hyperlink or a URL it detects) to the app as an open-URL action. The shell's action callback handles only the search actions, so the request is dropped and nothing opens. Ghostty's own macOS app (~/src/ghostty) opens the URL with NSWorkspace; do the same, and check a devenv pane's link opens on the laptop too.
title: 🔗 Cmd-clicking a link in a pane does nothing
